subject: Air freight quote to JFK
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you send me an all-in air freight quote in EUR for the cheapest option to JFK (New York, US), including the truck you’d arrange from our site in 35110 (Giessen), Germany, to the departure airport?

The sports equipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27. It’s 2 pieces, with a gross weight of 1483 kg and a total volume of 9.50 cbm.

Could you attach the offer as a PDF to your reply? Our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
